markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (74%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu (16%) stays in the 90% prediction set [F1]; deeper levels are drafted for this simulated frozen section.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 74%, InSitu 16%, Benign 10%, Invasive 1% | Favors Normal; minimal invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu (90% coverage, n=132) | Cannot exclude InSitu at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% / 1.0 OOD (12/12 tiles) [F6] | Passes QC despite resample degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Normal (80%) [F5]; nearest InSitu (79%) | Mostly Normal; closest neighbor InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.03), pushes away from invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Unreliable (0/20 spot check), low score (-0.20) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (0.02), raises invasive score [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable (0/20 spot check), below-typical score · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 risk deletion beats random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion +0.0008, CI -0.0088–0.0064); relies on unreliable mitoses and normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated frozen-section resampling (severity 3) masks InSitu like nearest neighbor BACH_0320 (duct confinement, pleomorphism differ).
- Focal lesion exists in high-risk regions 10 (0.96) or 6 (0.53) despite clear margins (lateral 86%) [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 10, 6**: Highest risk (0.96, 0.53); inspect for stromal invasion or in situ carcinoma.
2. **Regions 5, 8**: Check ductal atypia and pleomorphism (validated, 18/20) to separate Normal from InSitu.
3. **Regions 3, 7**: Verify lateral margin (86% segment) and review drafted deeper levels (stains blocked).
